name: io.github.Dosidal/dosidal
title: Dosidal: prescription medicine records for AI agents
description: Dosidal powers the agentic era of pharma. Prescription medicine records for AI agents and AI labs.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a medicine's card. Give the card's address or any one of three codes: the barcode on the pack (Global Trade Item Number, GTIN), the national pack code, or the authorisation number. Returns the signed card with its stamp; or a list of cards where several share the code; or an empty list. Each fetch leaves a signed receipt.

code.description: a card's address, or a pack barcode (GTIN), a national pack code or an authorisation number

tools.name: verify_card
tools.description: Check a card's signature against Dosidal's public keys.

tools.name: changes
tools.description: List the real changes to a country's cards since a date.

market.description: market code, e.g. FR, US, JP

after.description: read on from this entry (the value of next)

reissues.description: also list reissues, each marked reissued
